Data.title: Total Requirement Coefficients By Broad Sector, 2022
Data.footnote: This table shows the Leontief Inverse, commonly known as the Output Multipliers Table. Each column shows the total direct and indirect input requirements from industries, for every 1,000 units of an industry’s final output.
